description: This file implements the Wayland seat interface, managing input devices such as pointers, keyboards, and touch devices, including their creation, destruction, and event handling.

methods.name: pointer_set_cursor
methods.description: Handles setting the cursor image for a pointer device.

methods.name: seat_get_pointer
methods.description: Creates and initializes a pointer resource for a seat.

methods.name: seat_get_keyboard
methods.description: Creates and initializes a keyboard resource for a seat.

methods.name: seat_get_touch
methods.description: Creates and initializes a touch resource for a seat.

methods.name: bind_seat
methods.description: Binds the seat interface to a client.

methods.name: BindSeatInterface
methods.description: Initializes the seat interface on the Wayland display.
